title: Unit 22 Consolidation: Computational Linguistics, Algorithmic Thought & Small-Language Survival
goal: I can master C1 academic vocabulary of computational linguistics, neural networks, and digital erosion.
I can deploy speculative futuristic modals, algorithmic passive structures, and epistemic probabilities.
I can evaluate counterfactual language survival scenarios and Karinthy Frigyes's Faremidó vision.
